title: India's food, a gall bladder attack and Maori musicians in Singapore
summary: He recounts the curry that hurt him and hearing a Maori jazz band.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: How'd you like India and how did the Indians like an American Indian?

Oh, India, that's my Waterloo, that food, oh, that curry! These people took me under their wing -- come and have dinner with us. I went, that was good food, oh, my goodness. I began to have pains in my gall bladder and when I left Louie I had the gall bladder attack and a good thing I was home, you know. In Japan -- the food in Japan. Oh, yes, and we played Singapore, too, that was a Maori musicians band, a great jazz band, Maori tribe. playing in the Hotel Singapore where we stayed, they're beautiful musicians, wonderful musicians.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
There's jazz all over the world. You have the Maori people.
